[SWS_CM_00102] Uniqueness of offered service on local machine
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00200, RS_CM_00101, RS_CM_00108
⌈
Upon a call to
OfferService()
the Communication Management shall check the
offered service for uniqueness on the local machine using information available to
the service discovery. If the implementation detects a service instance duplication
(i.e., a service with the same
serviceInstanceId
,
serviceInterfaceId
and
majorVersion
on the same VLAN (e.g.according to [constr_1723] of [5]) is already
registered, the requested service offering shall not start, and the function shall return
positively.
⌋
Note: System/vehicle-wide Uniqueness of offered service
(see [RS_CM_00108]);
System/vehicle-wide uniqueness should be targeted in a best-effort way, i.e., if knowl-
edge about a remotely offered service is available, this knowledge shall be used in the
uniqueness check.
